items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: I paid 60 cents to go in and hear that great Fletcher Henderson's band... And I just had to see that band.

ctx.x: Now, when you were playing the shows, now, you have -- did you have to play -- the band played for -- they played for meetings and dances?
Yeah, Dusty Best of Fletcher, Ables and Esther [Lieder] oh, just I played in many acts.
Well, did -- how did you like doing that part of it? Did you like that part of the show?
